summary: Copies 9 bytes from a2 into the this buffer via sub_587DD0, then ORs each of the first four bytes with a byte sourced from an address derived from argument a4 (the decompiler renders the source index as v6[&a4 - this]), then copies 4 bytes from a3 into this+16 via sub_587DD0 and returns that call's result. The bytewise OR transform is confirmed by the raw source; the caller and the purpose of the transform are unknown.

local_names.this: output byte buffer: 9-byte copy target, then 4-byte OR target, then a 4-byte copy target at +16
local_names.a2: source buffer for the initial 9-byte copy
local_names.a3: source buffer for the final 4-byte copy at this+16
local_names.a4: argument whose home address is used as the OR-source base (rendered as &a4)
local_names.v6: running byte pointer over this[0..3] during the OR loop
local_names.v7: loop counter initialized to 4 and decremented each iteration

operations.description: sub_587DD0(this, a2, 9) — copy 9 bytes from a2 into the this buffer
do { *v6 |= v6[&a4 - this]; ++v6; --v7; } while (v7) — four iterations OR each of the first four bytes of this with a byte read from an address computed from the a4 argument location
return sub_587DD0(this + 16, a3, 4) — copy 4 bytes from a3 into this+16 and return the call's result
